## A turmeric mill beyond the farm

A 2021 case study describes another route through Chatikona. At Marthaguda, Harsha Trust and Selco Foundation supported a solar-powered turmeric mill in March 2020. The Maa Mahalaxmi Women Turmeric Producer Group bought boiled turmeric from Chatikona wholesalers supplied by Dongria Kondh growers in Kurli. Members ground and packed it for sale at Chatikona and Bissamcuttack.[^5]

The case identifies working-capital shortages and pandemic restrictions as obstacles. Milling still required money for stock and access to customers. The account connects the group to Dongariya suppliers through traders; it does not establish the members’ community identity or higher prices for growers.
